items.title: Green Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to be green with envy? Be a green teen!

+ 10 green teen skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: KA Studios Merch
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Become a part of the KA Studios Family with these awesome trendy merch skins!

- 7 HD Skins
- Merch
- By KA Studios

items.title: Pixel Fade
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Fun bright and colourful skins to brighten up your day.
One free skin!

items.title: Summer Gift
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
A summer gift from Cypress Games for the Minecraft players!

+ 8 Summer themed free skins

items.title: Jolicraft's Robot Lab HD
items.creator: Jolicraft
items.description:
Welcome to Jolicraft's Robot Lab! Robots are awesome. They don't need to eat (except when they do), they are shiny (except when they're not), and they do what you tell them to (except when they don't). 
+ Now YOU can be the ROBOTS!
+ 12 clunky robot skins to choose from!
+ Goes great with JOLICRAFT texture pack!

items.title: Techno Suits
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Suit up! These colorful and powerful Techno Suits are here to make you look like a cyberpunk robot. Explore the stars and futuristic worlds with these mech armors! Choose your favorite suit among these sci-fi pioneers!

- 12 skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: PETS!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
PETS! adds super cute pet animals into your world! Includes custom dogs and cat pets that you can take with you in the world! Treat these animals with care and they will show love back to you.

+ Includes custom pet dogs and cats
+ Full neighborhood world
+ Fun for roleplaying or survival

items.title: Alienvasion
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: The Aliens are out to wreck havoc on your worlds. 12 Unique alien skins to impress your friends with.

items.title: BLOCK CAMO 3
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
This camo pack includes 10 skins! Do you want to masquerade as a block or ore? BLOCK CAMO 3 skin pack will make sure you blend in with the overworld.

+ By ChewMingo

items.title: Skyblock Biomes Parkour
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Use your parkour skills to explore new islands and biomes in this custom skyblock world!

- Custom islands 
- Find loot and resources on the surrounding islands
- Expand your skyblock base
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Circus
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
What's the most popular thing a child looks forward to? Right the circus. It must be an incredible feeling to have a huge audience around you and to do tricks with animals.
You now have the chance to experience this feeling of freedom with this package.

+ 10 different skins
+ Circus
+ Clowns
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Cute Robots
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Do you think Robots are so cute? You can be a cute robot yourself if you could choose between the 10 different skins. That's a lot I know, but if you can identify with a robot then it can change your life.

+ 10 different skins
+ Pure sweetness
+ Robots
+ Cute
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Pink Frenzy
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Love to dress up in pink? Choose between 12 cool and unique pink outfits to spice up your skin collection! Pick your favorite and be the king or queen of the server!

- 12 pink skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Cave Creatures
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a creature from the dark depths of the caves!

+ 10 cave creature skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Crazy Masks
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Put your mask on and rock it like a superstar! You are at the craziest masquerade ball so its only fitting. Try the new collection of covers and become the scariest monster in the spotlight. Your mask says a lot about your personality, so choose the one that best fits you!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Trendy Prom Emperors
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
School is over, and prom night is here! Dance like you never danced before and be the king of the party. Enjoy the time with your friends and savor the taste of the last moment of high school! Everyone is waiting for the prom king and queen to be announced. Tonight is your last night of childhood!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Summer Madness
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The sun is hotter than hot, not a cloud in the sky, and a cool ocean breeze gently blows through your hair. Summer vacation along with all the fun and madness is here once again. Take a refreshing dive into the clear aqua blue water, build a sand castle, bury your friends up to their head in sand, or just relax and have fun!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Lucky Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Has your luck run out? That last roll on the lucky block went awry and let loose a monstrous series of glitches on the world! Will you take another chance and roll again hoping to block their entrance into the world? Or will you run while you still can?

- Includes 15 lucky block-inspired glitches!
- When the sky goes dark and the golden rift opens can you survive?

items.title: The Creeper
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Embody the life of your favorite monster! Is it the Creeper? If not, other Minecraft monsters skin packs are available at Pixelusion!

- 11 Creeper skins!
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Pirate Attack
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Ahoy! Which treasure hunting crew will you join in order to sail the seven seas? Will it be the undead captain who rules the watery depths? Or maybe the wizened captain, capable of negotiating his way out of any situation? Or even, the fierce captain queen who makes her enemies tremble under her might? Find out today!

- 15 dashing pirate skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Teens Revenge
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Two groups of teens are battling it out, seeking revenge on one another. Will you choose the fire or the ice team? Great skins for parkour races or PvP combat.

items.title: Bed Wars The Skin Pack
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Select your team, skin up, and power your way through the sky islands with this bed wars themed skin pack. Destroy the other teams' bed, whilst having your own bed right with you at all times. Game on!

- Ten unique skins
- Each skin comes in eight colours
- A massive eighty skins in total

Note: Other colours sold separately

items.title: Blocky Onesies
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
What is your favorite block? Whichever you choose, you'll love the blocky onesies in this pack! Now choose your favorite block and show off to everyone with your cute onesie!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Fruit Bomb
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Fruity flavors be popping in style today! Catch a taste of this fresh, fruit drip!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, colorful attire!
